hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -x node_modules/.bin/lntt ] && exit 0; if [ -f package-lock.json ] && [ ! -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then c='npm ci'; m='npm ci'; else c='pnpm install --frozen-lockfile'; m='pnpm install'; fi; if $c >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -x node_modules/.bin/lntt ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"lntt was missing: the dependencies are installed (%s)"}\n' "$c"; else printf '{"systemMessage":"lntt is not installed and %s failed: run %s"}\n' "$c" "$m"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: lntt: checking the dependencies are installed
